neighbours.label: ' for' or ' of' after an abstract framing noun that opens an explanation (reason for, way of, time of); ' of' after concrete nouns stays quiet. Japanese 'の' and Russian ' на' also appear in the top examples and are not tested
fire: A major reason for the shortage is the drought.
The main reason for his absence was illness.
One way of measuring risk is simple.
By the time of the war, it had closed.
Another reason for concern is cost.
A good way of learning is practice.
At the time of the fire, no one was home.
The reason for this remains unknown.
quiet: A major supplier of the shop is late.
The main door of his house was red.
One piece of paper is missing.
By the side of the road, it had stopped.
Another bag of rice is here.
A good cup of tea is nice.
At the top of the hill, no one was home.
The colour of this remains blue.

short: ' for' / ' of' after reason, way, time
